items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: I did that in rehearsal today — to Steve Promise.

ctx.x: Like I think about guys trying to tell guitar players to do a certain thing. You’re doing a swing tune and you say, “now do that Freddie Green thing.” I mean that’s such a contribution that’s something to be really proud of.
I did that in rehearsal today — to Steve Promise.
Did he know what you were talking about?
